title: Decimals are incorrectly handled in DivReducerNode
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  Node DivReducer is supposed to have 2 parents which are Redstone oracles and combine 2 prices. For example, to price ETH/USDC it will fetch 2 prices and divide `(ETH/USD) / (USDC/USD)`.
